Hi Marta — thanks for sending this over and for the packet. Forwarding to Procurement and Tax for verification. A few items from our side:

1) Notarization requirement
- For non-US entities we require either an apostille (if available) OR a notarized signature page plus a notarization cover letter from your local notary stating authority to notarize.

2) TIN / equivalent
- If you have a foreign tax identification number, include that on the cover letter. If not, provide the company registration number and the jurisdiction (you included Cayman certificate — that helps).

3) Additional evidence for PO activation
- We need a short bank letter confirming account ownership OR a recent (within 6 months) bank statement showing company name + account number masked.
- If the signature page is in a language other than English, please include a certified translation.

Procurement will place the PO on temporary hold until items above are uploaded to our secure intake portal. Grace — assigning to you for intake verification and to advise on timing. Karthik — FYI re withholding treatment, we may need to request a reduced withholding election if Everleaf qualifies.

Marta — ideally we can get notarized signature + bank letter by EOD Wednesday (10/07). If not, outline next-best timeline and whether you can provide an apostille.

Thanks,
Irene
Head of Vendor Risk & Compliance
Redwood Inference
